sloka: प्रणिपातप्रसन्ना हि मैथिली जनकात्मजा ।अलमेषा परित्रातुं राक्षस्यो महतो भयात् ।। ५.२७.४४।।।।
transliteration: praṇipātaprasannā hi maithilī janakātmajā ।alameṣā paritrātuṁ rākṣasyo mahato bhayāt ।। 5.27.44।।।।

translations.english: "O shedemons, this Janaka's daughter from Mithila who is capable of protecting you against great dangers will be pleased by your submission.
